summary: Take the first two nonzero values of row zero in left-to-right order as the palette and the first color-9 coordinate in row-major order as the seed. For each direction up, down, left, and right, start at the adjacent coordinate with step zero. While in bounds, paint the cell with palette[step modulo 2] only if its current value is zero, advance one coordinate and increment step regardless of occupancy. Process all four directions onto the evolving grid, preserving all original nonzero cells and output dimensions.
